components.description: Stacked areas flowing around a centre line — shows how the mix of 3–7 categories rises and fades over time; read the overall shape, not exact values. Expanded stacks to 100% to compare shares. React: <StreamGraph data={[{ date, series, value }]} offset="silhouette | expand" />

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
3–7 series; group the long tail into “Other”.
Largest or most stable series at the bottom (Expanded) or centre (Default).
Use for shape and change, not exact comparison — pair with a table or tooltip.
Same series colour as everywhere else in the product.
Not for precise values
Only the bottom layer has a flat baseline. If readers must compare values, use Line (Multi) or Bar (Stacked).
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Stacked areas flowing around a centre line — shows how a mix of categories rises and fades over time. Expanded stacks to 100%.
Encoding
x = time (point/linear), stacked y = value with silhouette offset (Default) or expand offset (Expanded), colour = series (categorical).
Interaction
Hover → vertical crosshair, tooltip with every series at that date.
